ops.title: PR 1316: match tap verdict destination instead of any mentioned SHA
ops.description: Owner: PR #1316 implementation lane (agentic-judge-landing). Static review only; no tests run. Evidence: board_rows.py:510-512; runner templates at desk-runner.py:6966-6967 and :6983. tap_verdict accepts any SHA in the runner text as the target head, although every note names the old tap and may list intermediate heads. Thus an A-to-B judgment can clear re-ask or set pure for a row at A or an intermediate C that was never judged as the destination. Next executable step: parse or record the explicit destination and bind the verdict to its transition and board block; add CI counterexamples for old and intermediate heads.

ops.text: A verdict for destination B cannot clear re-ask or mark pure for old head A or intermediate C.
A verdict for the requested PR and destination B continues to count.
